events.text: {name} stands beside the door with a sidearm on the hip and the posture of someone who has been told to look bored on purpose. 'Docked and paid?' {name} asks. 'Then you are no trouble to me. Keep your weapon down and your hands to yourself, and I will not have to write anything.'

outcomes.text: 'Pickpockets in the market, and a cold section aft where the lights went. Nothing in the cold section is mine to guard.' {name} nods at a locked cabinet. 'Not that one either. Mind it.'

choices.text: Say you are only passing through.

events.text: {name} is counting the minutes to the end of the shift on the wall clock and does not mind who sees it. 'Eleven minutes,' {name} says. 'Then it is somebody else's quiet corridor. If you are buying anything, buy it now. The stall by the hub gives a guard's price.'

outcomes.text: 'Do not thank me,' says {name}. 'Tell no one I said it.' A ration bar is pressed into your hand, still warm from a pocket.

events.text: {name} leans on the doorframe where the light stops. Past it the corridor is dark and the air smells of cold metal. 'Aft section lost its power,' {name} says, without being asked. 'Generator room is back there. Somebody has to hold a button for a while and nobody on this shift will. Not that I told you.'

outcomes.text: 'Dark. Dead doors. Whatever got in before we sealed it.' {name} taps the sidearm, once. 'Go if you like. I am paid to stand here.'
{name} nods at the dark as if it owed a favour.
